title: 长相思·其一（长相思，在长安）
author: 李白
intro: On an autumn night in Chang’an a man lies awake longing for a beauty who seems as far away as the clouds. Sky above, waves below, mountain passes between — even his dreams can’t reach her.
analysis: 这首诗写一个人在长安的秋夜里，深深思念一位远方的美人。开头三个字“长相思”直接点题，然后写秋夜的景物：纺织娘在井栏边叫着，薄霜冷冷的，竹席也透出寒意；一盏孤灯昏暗不明，相思得快要断了气，卷起窗帘望着月亮，只能白白叹气。“美人如花隔云端”是全诗的中心：她美得像花，却像隔在云的那一头，看得见、够不着。下半首写距离：上有高远辽阔的青天，下有清水的波浪，天那么长、路那么远，连做梦都飞不过关山。最后又回到“长相思”，加上“摧心肝”，痛到心碎。诗的句子有长有短（三言、七言交错），读起来一会儿急一会儿缓，像心情在起伏。古人还认为“美人”可能是比喻君王或理想，表达诗人离开长安后得不到重用的苦闷。
analysisEn: A man in Chang’an lies awake on an autumn night, longing for a beautiful woman far away. The poem opens with its title, “Endless longing — in Chang’an”, then sets the scene: a katydid chirps by the golden well-rail, a thin frost settles, even the bamboo mat feels cold. A single lamp burns dim; his longing is almost unbearable, and he rolls up the curtain to gaze at the moon, sighing for nothing. Then the heart of the poem: “My beauty, lovely as a flower, is beyond the clouds.” She is visible in his mind, but out of reach. The second half is all distance — the blue-black sky above, clear waves below, sky so wide and road so long that even his dreaming soul can’t fly over the mountain passes. It ends where it began, with “endless longing”, now “breaking my heart”. Short three-character lines alternate with long seven-character ones, so the rhythm hurries and slows like a troubled mind. Traditional readers often took the “beauty” as a symbol of the emperor or of the poet’s ideals, written after Li Bai had to leave the court in Chang’an. Either way, the longing is real.
background: Li Bai (701–762) spent less than two years at the imperial court in Chang’an before being sent away in 744. “Endless Longing” is an old yuefu title for love poems; this one is often thought to date from after his departure, though the date is uncertain.
pronunciation: 络纬 luò wěi；金井阑 lán；簟 diàn；思欲绝的“思”读 sī；卷帷 juǎn wéi；青冥 míng；渌水 lù shuǐ；摧 cuī；“长相思”“长安”“长叹”“长天”“天长”的“长”都读 cháng。机器朗读“簟”“渌”容易读错，已在“朗读用字”列替换同音字，音频需人工听验。
version: 采用通行本，为李白《长相思》二首之第一首（“长相思，在长安”），网站按句读排为十一行。异文：“微霜”一作“凝霜”，“孤灯不明”一作“孤灯不寐”，“美人如花”一作“佳期迢迢”。

lines.py: cháng xiāng sī, zài cháng ān
luò wěi qiū tí jīn jǐng lán
lines.lit: The katydid cries in autumn by the golden well-rail;
lines.en: A katydid sings its autumn song beside the golden well;

lines.py: wēi shuāng qī qī diàn sè hán
lines.lit: light frost is chill, the bamboo mat looks cold.
lines.en: a thin frost falls, chill, and even my bamboo mat feels cold.

lines.py: gū dēng bù míng sī yù jué
lines.lit: A lone lamp is not bright; my longing is about to break;
lines.en: By one dim lamp my longing is near breaking;

lines.py: juǎn wéi wàng yuè kōng cháng tàn
lines.lit: rolling up the curtain, I gaze at the moon and sigh long in vain.
lines.en: I roll up the curtain, look at the moon, and sigh — for nothing.

lines.py: měi rén rú huā gé yún duān
lines.lit: The beauty, like a flower, is separated by the clouds’ edge.
lines.en: My beauty, lovely as a flower, is far beyond the clouds.

lines.py: shàng yǒu qīng míng zhī cháng tiān
lines.lit: Above is the long sky, dark blue and deep;
lines.en: Above me, the vast dark-blue sky;

lines.py: xià yǒu lù shuǐ zhī bō lán
lines.lit: below are the waves of clear water.
lines.en: below me, the waves of clear water.

lines.py: tiān cháng lù yuǎn hún fēi kǔ
lines.lit: The sky is long, the road far; the soul flies in pain;
lines.en: The sky so wide, the road so long — my soul tires as it flies,

lines.py: mèng hún bù dào guān shān nán
lines.lit: the dreaming soul cannot arrive — the passes and mountains are hard.
lines.en: and even in dreams it can’t cross the mountain passes to her.

lines.py: cháng xiāng sī, cuī xīn gān
lines.lit: Long longing breaks heart and liver.
lines.en: Endless longing tears my heart apart.

words.en: katydid (an insect that chirps in autumn)
words.note: 俗名“纺织娘”，现代说“蝈蝈儿”一类的昆虫。
现代汉语“摇摇欲坠”“欲望”。

words.en: to break off; to the extreme

words.note: 古义副词“白白地”；今天“空”多是“空的、没有东西”。
现代也说，如“云端”服务、“站在云端”。
现代汉语“波澜壮阔”“波澜不惊”。

words.en: the soul that travels in dreams
words.note: 古人相信梦里灵魂能出游；现代说“梦里”。
泛指路途遥远，现代书面语还用。

imagery.name: 月
imagery.zh: 卷帘望月，月光照见诗人无法排遣的相思。
imagery.en: He rolls up the curtain to gaze at the moon, which lights up a longing he cannot shake off.

imagery.name: 灯
imagery.zh: 一盏昏暗的孤灯陪着失眠的人，写出秋夜的孤单。
imagery.en: A single dim lamp keeps the sleepless man company and makes the night feel lonelier.

imagery.name: 霜
imagery.zh: 微霜和冷簟写出秋夜的寒意，也写出心里的冷。
imagery.en: Thin frost and a cold mat give the chill of autumn — and the chill in his heart.
